items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Lala, the one the managing Harry Wills.

ctx.x: That's across the street from the Paris Preal. No, no, no. Put the picture in the wrong building. Yeah, that's the first place I played with Piron. But I came to Norway, we came to Norway with Kid Ory from Laplace. But we disbanded because Kid and Ory were getting to get too big and big, so his head began to swell. We wanted the orchestra a piece. So he got, he got his orchestra, I got one too. I was playing with Frank at Ducey. Oh, the Eagle Band. The Eagle Band. Yes. Buck Johnson was playing. Yeah, Buck, me,…
